journey.name: Phase 2 mobile PIN gate — parent to child with lock
journey.description: Verifies the mobile PIN flow end to end with synthetic content: the parent sets a PIN and assigns an approved lesson, the child plays and completes it in child mode, returning to parent tools requires the PIN, a wrong PIN is rejected, and after a full app restart the gate re-arms and saved progress is still visible to the unlocked parent.

actions.action: Sign up with android-pin@example.test and SyntheticJourney2026 and grant both consents through the dialog
Create profile FoxOne and verify the library screen appears
Upload counting.pdf from Downloads and wait for three draft lessons
Open the first draft, approve it, go back, and assign it
Tap Set parent PIN, enter 2468, save, and verify the parent tools stay unlocked
Tap Child play, open the assigned lesson, complete all five activities, and verify the completion card shows 20 of 20
Exit child play and verify the PIN gate appears instead of parent tools
Enter the wrong PIN 1111 and verify the wrong-PIN message appears
Enter the correct PIN 2468 and verify the parent dashboard with the progress card showing the completed lesson
Force-stop and relaunch the app, sign in again, and verify the PIN gate re-arms after sign-in
Enter the correct PIN 2468 and verify the progress card still shows the completed lesson
